steps.note: Open the prepared live reverse auction with Vendor A's existing bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Move to the separate Vendor A supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the live reverse auction's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Revise the existing bid to 90 and submit it, replacing the previous 100 bid.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the revised bid.
Return to the buyer-side Responses screen.
Confirm the buyer still sees Vendor A's direct response after the revision.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid to inspect the revised bid.
Assert that Master QCS uses the revised bid rate of 90.
Confirm the updated bid participates in the live ranking and is ranked correctly.
